title: Why a Power Pose Gives You an Instant Confidence Boost
hook: Standing tall for two minutes makes you feel more confident.

narration.text: Standing tall for two minutes makes you feel more confident.
This is not just a mental trick. It is a real physical effect.
Your body language can actually change your brain chemistry.
Posing powerfully can increase helpful hormones and reduce stress hormones.
This concept is called embodied cognition, where your physical state affects your mind.
So, before a big meeting, try a power pose for a noticeable boost.
It is a simple way to take control of how you feel, instantly.
Have you ever tried a power pose before a challenge?

description: Discover the surprising science behind why a 'power pose' can genuinely make you feel more confident. Learn about embodied cognition and how your physical actions can influence your internal state and brain chemistry. This simple technique offers an instant boost when you need it most.
topic: Why you feel a boost of confidence after standing in a 'power pose', explaining embodied cognition.
